name: Gong
description: Gong's hosted server reads calls, transcripts and deal activity. It needs a paid Gong seat.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.gong.io) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
